english.notes:
(i) The penalty for this offence has changed from summary imprisonable to now being an either way offence, this is with effect from 1/4/17. If this offence has been committed prior to this date then use H4780 CJS Code AT01033.
(ii) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions or the Treasury MAY be required - see paragraph 8 of Schedule 3 to the Act.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see paragraph 7(7) of the Schedule to the Anti-Terrorism, Crime and Security Act 2001 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
